page.title: Multi-Device Control
page.subtitle: Control up to 5 computers from one keyboard and mouse

session.title: Control Session
session.needTwo: Add at least one secondary device

layout.title: Screen Layout
layout.dragHint: Drag devices to arrange their positions. Click a secondary device to enable/disable it.

modal.title: Enroll a New Device
modal.instructions: Generate a one-time enrollment token, then run the Flow Device Agent on the target computer using that token. The token expires after 5 minutes and can only be used once.
modal.step2: Download and install the Flow Device Agent on the target computer
modal.step3: Run the agent with the enrollment token
modal.securityWarning: This token is shown only once. Copy it now — it cannot be retrieved again.

confirm.revoke: Revoke this device? It will no longer be able to connect. This cannot be undone.
confirm.delete: Permanently delete this device? All session history will be lost.
